title: THE OMNI Flame Powered Extraction Device
description:
THE OMNI
NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE
DynaVap’s flagship Thermal Extraction Device, The Omni.
Let us begin with the tip. A
Nona notched completely contoured extraction chamber
that doubles as a built in grinder sits atop a
trisected 9 fin profile
. Contained inside the extraction chamber is our two position
Adjust-a-Bowl feature
that allows you to adjust the size of the dosing chamber to your needs.
The stem is enhanced with an
intuitive tactile navigation geometry
making it easier than ever to find the
twin turbulating airports
. Opposite the airport you will find a
compound angled rocker
that facilities quick and easy hand movement when modulating the airports.
The Omni Series’ prime feature of airflow control has been updated to include a
dial-indicator for visual airflow adjustment
and a variable pitch,
helical heat exchanging condenser
that further cools the air as it passes through the device.
Comes with a Captive Cap and will fit in any XL size DynaStash or SlimStash.
PRODUCT CHARACTERISTICS
Cap
Captive Cap
Condenser
OMNI XL Condenser
Midsection
Titanium Stem
Total Length
109 mm
Included
1 x THE OMNI
